title: ISO/IEC 27001 certification asked by customers
description: Proposed for software publishers: keep it when the organization holds or prepares an ISO/IEC 27001 certification of its information security management system and the project falls within its scope. It activates the same iso-27001 pack as the iso-27001-isms method.

sources.title: ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 27 Journal, July 2022, ISO/IEC 27002:2022 (93 controls that form Annex A of ISO/IEC 27001)
